1968 · Civil rights · Assassination

Martin Luther King Jr.

King was expanding from civil rights into opposition to the Vietnam War, economic redistribution, labour organising, and the Poor People's Campaign. King's assassination removed the most influential leader connecting racial justice, labour rights, anti-war politics, and economic reform.

1968 · Political leader · Assassination

Robert F. Kennedy

Kennedy was a leading presidential candidate campaigning on civil rights, poverty, Vietnam, and institutional reform. His death transformed the 1968 election and ended another major Kennedy path to the presidency.
